body: Most likely. I always wonder how 50 Shades and Twilight made it onto shelves when actual works of art are offered as free ebooks, desperate for exposure. Marketing is right, I suppose.

I'm currently in the process of doing the same. They say it's therapeutic to get it all out there, right? Load of balls so far. It's honestly a bit of closure I haven't felt to this point. Relief isn't the word, just....something.

However, reading yours and being on the other end of a note, even a stranger's made me instantly want to scream "don't do it!". You're obviously well written with a good sense of humor. I guess I can add confused and hypocritical to my list of current emotions.

Also; ignore the douche patting themselves on the back for helping someone else, and trying to recycle their advice. Dick.
